source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
Each friendly **KILL TEAM** unit that has this ability gains 3 abilities, each working while the named doctrine is active for it:

- **Furor Tactics** (**devastator doctrine**): its attacks gain **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**.
- **Malleus Tactics** (**tactical doctrine**): its attacks gain **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**.
- **Purgatus Tactics** (**assault doctrine**): its attacks targeting enemy units up to 9" away from it gain **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)**.

Army restrictions:

- You may include **ADEPTUS ASTARTES DEATHWATCH** units; **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** units of any other Chapter are not allowed.
- No **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEATHWATCH** units may be included, except **KILL TEAM CASSIUS** (see Legends: Agents of the Imperium).
